title: Design: Delete Customer window names the customers that bill to it
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer P with no work orders, assets or contacts, so only the Bill To rule can stop the delete.
  • Have customer Q with customer P saved as its Bill Invoices To.
  • Start on customer P's page.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p6-05-after-delete-customer-refused.png, bt-p6-03-before-confirmation.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Click the edit icon.
  2. Click Delete.
  3. Click Delete in the Confirmation window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Customer opens; Delete is offered.

Step 2:

  • The usual Confirmation window asks "Are you sure you want to delete this company?" with Cancel and Delete.

Step 3:

  • A "Delete Customer" window opens on top, its title row on a yellow background.
  • It reads "This customer is the default Bill To for [customer Q's name]. Remove it from that customer first." with customer Q as an underlined blue link in a bulleted list.
  • Buttons: grey "Cancel" then blue "Remove As Default Bill To", bottom right.

Words in square brackets stand for the value they name, such as customer A's name exactly as it is saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12314 (Story 12, Deleting a customer that pays for others)

  • S12-R1: “Deleting a customer that is another customer's saved default is refused, opening a "Delete Customer" window.”
  • S12-R2: “The window shows the refusal message and each dependent customer as a link to its page.”
  • S12-R3: “The window has "Cancel" and "Remove As Default Bill To" buttons.”
  • S12-R8: “Today's delete refusals come first; the "Delete Customer" window shows only when being another customer's default is the only reason.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "6 Deleting a customer that pays for others", pictures "Delete Customer refused" (New, no before exists), "Confirmation" (Production (v26.45.2.1)).
